svg.title: DoRA decomposes each frozen weight vector into a trainable magnitude and a LoRA-updated direction.
svg.desc: The frozen direction V from W₀ is updated by the same low-rank B×A product LoRA uses, then normalized column-wise and scaled by a separately trained magnitude m, giving W′ = m·normalize_c(V+BA). This adds a degree of freedom beyond standard LoRA, and its extra parameters and computation should be verified against a LoRA baseline before adoption.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: DoRA trains magnitude and direction separately

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: A LoRA-style update handles direction; a new scalar handles magnitude.
